name: vedirect
description: VE.Direct for LRAN - HEX frames (build, check, read Get and Set replies) and the text parser that separates them from the 1 Hz text blocks on one UART. osh-labs/VE.Direct_mppt_arduino is the reference of record; LRAN transports HEX strings verbatim (LRAN-Protocol-Specification 7.6). Arduino-free.
